source_trace_cause: HeadCalc with SWKIMPL=0 initializes state%kmean(NN+1)=state%k(NN) from the timestep base state and does not update conductivity during Newton iterations.
Mode-5 pressure-head solves therefore use a lagged face conductivity with the iterated candidate head gradient.
After the solve, mod_reference_richards_legacy_binding materializes state%qbot from the exact SWAP water-balance grouping rather than publishing the raw Darcy face product.
Kernel terminal_bottom_outward_flux_native is the sign-adapted materialized solve_result%bottom_flux, not a raw face-operator observable.

stage_A1_operator_audit.purpose: Bind geometry, sign and constitutive inversion on one common accepted state, without mistaking balance-materialized qbot for the raw Darcy face operator.
stage_A1_operator_audit.identity_reason: For D3/D4 the last reduced layer is exactly the fine 150-160 cm control volume, so theta_bar_N equals emitted node-16 theta on the projected accepted state.
stage_A1_operator_audit.reported_terminal_qbot_rule: Compare state-operator flux to the balance-materialized terminal qbot only as a time-level/materialization diagnostic. It is not an identity gate.
stage_A1_operator_audit.lagged_reference_semantics: The executable Reference mode-5 residual uses base-state K_face when SWKIMPL=0 and candidate-state head gradient. This will be compared at full-dynamics level, not silently folded into the LARE boundary formula.
stage_A1_operator_audit.sourceface_rule: Report state-operator sensitivity only; no selection or fitting.
